sensitivity_analysis.conclusion: Bioavailability (F), Volume of Distribution (Vd), and Body Weight (W) exert 1:1 first-order dominance on exposure (AUC), while absorption rate ka modulates Tmax and peak sharpness without altering total systemic exposure.
